name: Scheduler
descriptor: Things that come round again: when you last did it, how often it should be done, and the date it is next due.
verify_checks: recur: the next-due maths is emitted
pros: the next date is computed, so it cannot go stale when you skip a week
the due count in the strip turns the list into a worklist
one interval per task, in days: no cron, no rules to learn
it works entirely offline, which is when you actually do the chore
cons: days only: no weekly, monthly or business-day rules
one interval per task, no seasonal variation
no history: only the last time is kept, not the previous ones
a missed task does not shift its own schedule
best_for: maintenance you do at a rough interval
avoid_if: the schedule needs calendar rules or a history
